Simple advice for visitors
It is easier with this note
Travel with pets needs clear checks.
Aurelia Skyways keeps the Companion Animal Travel Desk ready to guide you through booking, documents, and handoff. Check carrier fit, leash use, and feed-and-water plans before you arrive. The team will tell you what to prepare and what to avoid, so your pet can move through the journey with less stress.
For birds, <<FACT F065>> Keep papers clean and easy to show, and carry the health certificate with the rest of the travel file. <<FACT F083>> Small mistakes can delay boarding, so review the crate, label, and comfort items before leaving home.
If anything is unclear, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel.
